adityasaini404/PadhteRaho-Apk.releaseNotes:
Welcome to the biggest update of PadhteRaho! We have completely rewritten the core engine and redesigned the app to give you a seamless, distraction-free learning experience. 

### 🎬 Brand New Pro Player (Powered by Media3)
* **No More iFrame:** The old web-based player is gone. We now use a native, lightning-fast **ExoPlayer**.
* **Gesture Controls:** Swipe up/down on the left for **Brightness**, right for **Volume**, and swipe horizontally to **Seek**.
* **Smart Controls:** Double-tap to skip 10s, long-press to play at 2x speed.
* **Picture-in-Picture (PiP):** Watch videos while using other apps.
* **Lock Screen & Notification:** Control your video directly from the notification panel or lock screen.
* **Resume Playback:** The app remembers exactly where you left off.

### 🎨 Material 3 UI Redesign
* **Fresh Home Screen:** Cleaner category grids, better typography, and a beautiful new search bar.
* **Redesigned Notes & Settings:** Smooth animations, rounded corners, and a much more organized settings menu.
* **New Dialogs:** Beautiful bottom sheets for Video Quality, Playback Speed, and Privacy Policies.

### ⚙️ Under the Hood
* **NewPipeExtractor:** Powered by NewPipe to bypass YouTube limits and fetch direct video streams.
* **Hindi Audio Support:** Improved audio track selection.
* **Cleaner Settings:** Removed unnecessary contact options. You can now reach out directly via Email.

### 🐛 Bug Fixes & Improvements
* Fixed the "Video Unavailable" crash completely.
* Resolved the app crashing on the Settings screen.
* Improved app startup speed and memory usage.

**Note:** If you are updating from v1.0.0, this is a major update and we highly recommend downloading it for the best experience. 

Happy Learning! ❤️

sumitkumartiwari19-sudo/SWAR-Music.releaseNotes:
# SWAR Music v1.1

## ✨ New Features

**Now Playing & Playback**
- Redesigned Now Playing screen with a Song/Video toggle, and a Like / Lyrics / Save / Download action row
- Album art now rotates (vinyl-style) during playback, with a rotational drag gesture on the art to seek forward/backward (audio mode only)
- Smooth, symmetric shared-element animation between the mini player and the Now Playing screen, in both directions
- Mini player now continues playing actual video (not just a static thumbnail) when collapsing from Video mode
- Picture-in-Picture (PiP) support for video playback, including auto-enter on Home button press
- Video quality selector (Auto / 1080p / 720p / 480p), shown only in Video mode
- Audio now streams at the highest available quality

**Search & Discovery**
- Search-as-you-type suggestions
- A highlighted "Top Result" card above regular search results for the best-matching track
- Songs played from Search now continue with related-song recommendations (instead of just the next search result), using both YouTube's related data and keyword matching, refined over time based on which songs get skipped quickly
- India-focused Home recommendations (Bollywood, regional, trending charts) with filtering to exclude movies, trailers, and other non-song content from search and suggestions
- Additional swipeable rows on Home: Trending, Made For You, and Based on Your History

**Library & Playlists**
- Full custom + YouTube-imported playlist support, including sharing and individually deleting any playlist
- A 3-dot menu on every song (Home, Search, and inside playlists) with Like, Save/Remove from playlist, Download/Delete, Share, and Add to Queue
- Confirmation prompts before any delete/remove action app-wide
- Swipeable Library categories (Playlists / Downloads / Liked / History)
- Offline message with a direct shortcut to your downloaded music when there's no internet connection

**Settings & Updates**
- Full Settings screen: Account, Appearance (including Light/Dark/Follow System), Playback, Downloads, Data Usage, Notifications, Library & History, Privacy, Backup, and About
- In-app update checker connected to GitHub Releases — notifies you on every launch until you update
- "Share SWAR Music" option to invite others to the app

**Downloads**
- Offline downloads now reliably save to your device and play back with no internet connection, and are preferred automatically even when you're online

## 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Fixed a launch crash and added built-in crash diagnostics for easier troubleshooting
- Fixed search and playback failures caused by an outdated extractor and missing initialization
- Fixed the wrong song playing when tapping a search result
- Fixed severely throttled download speeds and inaccurate/jumpy download progress
- Fixed downloads disappearing after reaching 100%, and downloads not saving an actual file to the device
- Fixed the Like button not saving your liked songs
- Fixed overlapping/broken layout on the Search screen and Now Playing screen (status bar overlap, misaligned header, broken result rows)
- Fixed album art rendering upside-down, and a brief wrong-shape flash during player collapse
- Fixed the mini player being taller than intended
- Fixed theme colors not updating immediately when switching between Light and Dark
- Fixed Library screen layout issues (count label, header not scrolling, visual corner glitches on cards)
- Fixed inconsistent/duplicate entries on the Downloads screen
- Fixed ads not displaying correctly (wrong sizing, a non-functional ad unit, one ad slot not loading) and an ad overlapping the mini player
- Fixed a crash related to the search engine in release builds
- Fixed all user data being lost on every app update
- Removed playlists that shipped built into the app — your Library now only shows playlists you've created or saved
- "Download only on Wi-Fi" is now off by default, so downloads work on mobile data out of the box

EchoMusicApp/Echo-Music.releaseNotes:
Every update aims to make the app a little better from every corner. Not every change will matter to everyone, but there should be something here for most people. This release brings Echo Connect for moving playback between your devices, a navigation bar that gets out of the way as you scroll, and a new Podcast tab. Here's what's new.

## Highlights

- **Echo Connect:** Hand off playback between your devices over your local network and control one device from another.
- **Collapsing navigation bar:** The bottom bar shrinks as you scroll, and the MiniPlayer moves in beside it.
- **Podcast tab:** Podcasts now have their own tab between Home and Search.
- **Spotify login:** Signing in to Spotify is more reliable.
- **Sync fixes:** Liked songs order and playlist sorting now stay correct, and local likes are no longer wiped.

## New Features

### Echo Connect

- **Playback handoff and remote control:** Move playback between devices on the same network with no server involved. From the other device you can play, pause, seek, skip, shuffle, repeat, change volume and manage the queue.
- **Remote playback in the player:** When playing on another device, the Player, MiniPlayer and floating MiniPlayer show its state and alternate between the codec and a "Playing On" badge.
- **Device pairing:** Pair devices with a 6-digit code that refreshes every 60 seconds. Pairing works in both directions, and an incoming code prompts you in the app.
- **Account and library sync:** Your Google account session, local playlists, Spotify playlists and podcast episodes sync automatically every 5 minutes.
- **Settings screen:** A new Echo Connect screen under Account offers pairing, Force Sync, Unpair and detailed sync logs.
- **Quick switcher:** Paired devices appear in the audio device sheet, which has a refreshed Material You design.
- **Player menu shortcut:** Echo Connect now sits below Song DNA in the player menu and opens the audio device sheet.
- **Podcast progress sync:** Episode progress now merges across devices.

### Navigation

- **Scroll-collapsing navigation bar:** Scrolling down collapses the bar into a pill showing your active tab, and the MiniPlayer slides down beside it. Tap the pill or scroll up to expand it again.
- **Podcast tab:** Podcasts are now in the bottom navigation bar, and the Podcasts chip is removed from the Home chip row.

### Interface

- **Desktop client banner:** The profile popup now shows a New Release banner for the desktop client. You can dismiss it permanently.

## Improvements

### Home and Library

- **Hero carousel:** The sliding carousel now sits at the top of Home, below the mood chips.
- **Shortcuts removed:** The Home shortcuts section and its toggle in Content Settings are gone.
- **Library spacing:** Removed the extra space at the top of Library screens and aligned padding across the In-App Library and Spotify Library tabs.

### Navigation and Menus

- **More Options order:** The menu now lists AI Hub, Recognition, then Shuffle. Recognise music has moved here from the bottom navigation bar.
- **Podcast categories:** All categories load automatically as you scroll.
- **Settings:** Listening Summary now appears next to Echo Wrapped.

### Artist Page

- **Artist video:** The video now plays behind the artist's photo at the top of the page. A chip names the song when it is a song's motion art. Only Apple Music videos are used.

### Playback

- **Playback reliability:** Improved audio stream resolution and cutoff handling.

### Localisation

- **French:** Added and refined French translations for Discord, music flow, home features, shortcuts and album art recolouring (#905, #918).

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed Spotify login and session failures, including expired sessions and confusion between signed-out and temporary network errors (#907, #854, #884).
- Fixed the sort order button in `SortHeader` changing into a circle when the direction changed (#907).
- Fixed the collapsed navigation bar not expanding when tapped, and its tap being blocked by the player.
- Fixed the grey square and the unexpected song that appeared next to the artist's name (#913).
- Fixed the order of liked songs after syncing (#849).
- Fixed local liked songs being wiped by an empty or failed sync (#851).
- Fixed saved playlists being overwritten by empty remote responses, and fixed playlist sorting by creation date (#788).
- Fixed missing titles, show names, thumbnails and durations in Continue listening for podcasts.
- Fixed short non-podcast items appearing in Continue listening.

## Internal

- Version bumped to 1.4.9 (build 170).
- Android CI now caches Robolectric runtime JARs, pre-fetches them with retries, and pins SDK 33 in the migration tests.
- Removed the default `WorkManagerInitializer` to fix a release lint error.
- Release builds fall back to debug signing when no release keystore is present locally.
- Applied Spotless formatting updates.
- Added Echo Connect documentation to the README and a detailed guide.
- Updated the README acknowledgements, `upcomingupdate.json` and `AGENT.md`.

## Contributors

Thank you to everyone who contributed to this release.

- @iad1tya: Maintainer. Echo Connect, navigation changes, Home and Library updates, sync and podcast fixes, CI and release work.
- @PurveshShinde: Spotify login and session fixes, and the sort header button fix (#907).
- @gerry02: Artist page video and header fix (#913).
- @Mickael81: French translations (#905, #918).
- @github-actions[bot]: Automated contributor list updates.

MuntashirAkon/AppManager.releaseNotes:
App Manager v4.1.1 improves permissions, installation, ADB connectivity, and several other parts of the application. Visit Settings > About > Version/Changelog for details.

**Revoke Internet Permission**
App Manager can now block internet for individual applications utilizing the eBPF rules in root or ADB mode. To block internet for an application, go to the "Uses permissions" tab and click on the toggle button next to `android.permission.INTERNET` to revoke the permission.
  
_Known Limitation._ The eBPF rules are lost after a reboot. App Manager attempts to restore the rules right after a reboot. However, in ADB mode, it might take a while to connect to wireless debugging depending on the availability of a Wi-Fi connection. This might allow applications that start after a reboot to use internet.  

**Others**
- Added support for editing `.bat` files  
- Improved installation reliability and performance  
- Improved permission management  
- Improved ADB pairing, connections, and mode handling  
- Improved settings transitions and startup messages  
- Fixed displaying profiles after creating a profile for the first time  
- Fixed intercepting browser URLs  
- Fixed listing applications on Android 17  
- Fixed title ordering in What's New dialog.  

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/MuntashirAkon/AppManager/compare/v4.1.0...v4.1.1

adityasaini404/LumoStore.releaseNotes:
## 🚀 Lumo Store v1.2.0 — Auto-Updates & Critical Fixes

Welcome to **v1.2.0**! This is a major update that makes Lumo Store smarter and much more reliable. We've introduced an automatic update system for the app itself, completely redesigned the app details screen, and squashed some critical bugs that were affecting the user experience.

Here is what's new, improved, and fixed in this release:

### ✨ New Features
*   **🔄 Self Auto-Update System:** Lumo Store can now check for its own updates! When a new version is available, you will get a beautiful prompt to update instantly. 
*   **⚙️ APK Variants Selection:** For apps that offer multiple architectures (ARM64, ARMv7, x86), you can now select the exact variant you want using a clean dropdown menu next to the Install button. This saves storage and improves performance.
*   **📥 Real Download Counts:** We now fetch and display the **real download counts** directly from GitHub for every app.

### 🎨 UI & UX Improvements
*   **Redesigned App Details:** A much cleaner layout with a collapsible "What's New" changelog, easier variant selection, and a stunning new download confirmation dialog.
*   **Better Install Flow:** The download progress bar is now properly anchored to the bottom of the screen, showing live download speeds, file sizes, and estimated time remaining.
*   **Smarter Search:** The search bar now filters apps instantly by name as you type.

### 🐛 Major Bug Fixes
*   **Fixed "Open" Button Issue:** Apps that were already installed but not showing the "Open" button are now perfectly detected. We added multiple fallback detection methods to bypass Android 11+ package visibility restrictions.
*   **Fixed False Update Prompts:** Resolved a critical version-comparison bug (caused by mismatched version formats like `v1.0` vs `1.0.0`) that incorrectly showed "Update" for apps that were already on the latest version.
*   **Fixed Auto-Installer:** The Android OS installer dialog now automatically opens right after the download completes without getting stuck or hiding behind the app.
*   **Fixed JSON Parsing Errors:** Resolved the issue where bad formatting in the remote `apps.json` file would cause the entire store to fail loading.

---

### 📲 Installation
1. Download the `lumostore.apk` from the **Assets** section below.
2. Enable "Install from unknown sources" if prompted.
3. Tap the APK to install over your existing Lumo Store app.
*(Your favorites, profile, and settings will be preserved!)*

### 🌐 Links
*   **Website:** [adityasaini404.github.io/LumoStore](https://adityasaini404.github.io/LumoStore/)
*   **Source Code:** [github.com/adityasaini404/LumoStore](https://github.com/adityasaini404/LumoStore)
*   **Catalog Repo:** [github.com/adityasaini404/lumo-store-apps](https://github.com/adityasaini404/lumo-store-apps)

---
**A huge thank you to everyone who tested the app and helped find these bugs. Lumo Store is growing fast!** 💜
**Made with ❤️ in India by Aditya Saini.**

🎵 SKT Music Player v2.0.2 — A Smoother, Smarter Music Experience

What's new in v2.0.2?

A major refinement over v2.0.1, bringing smoother animations, smarter playlists, enhanced customization, and a beautiful new home screen widget.

✨ What's New

- 🎶 Redesigned Playlist Screen: Playlists now open correctly with dedicated screens, Play and Shuffle controls, song removal, and playlist deletion.
- ❤️ Smart Playlists: Automatically access Favourites, Recently Played, Most Played, and Recently Added.
- 🏠 Improved Home Shortcuts: Favourites and Recent shortcuts now open the correct playlists.
- 🎨 6 Beautiful App Themes: System Default, Dark, AMOLED Black, Light, Midnight Blue, and Frosted Glass.
- 🌈 Dynamic Artwork Colors: Optionally adapt the app's colors to the currently playing song's album artwork.
- 🎬 4 UI Animation Styles: Customize interface transitions in Settings, with Shared Axis as the default.
- ↔️ Swipe to Change Songs: Swipe the mini player left or right, with 6 smooth animation styles, including Fade Drift by default.
- 📱 Seamless Mini-to-Full Player Transition: Enjoy a smooth, finger-following animation when expanding the mini player, powered by Container Morph by default, with 2 additional styles available in Settings.
- ⬆️ More Reliable Player Gestures: Improved swipe-up detection for opening the full player.
- ❄️ Refined Frosted Glass UI: A darker, softly blurred mini player and navigation bar keep text readable while maintaining a premium look.
- 🎧 New Home Screen Widget: Vinyl-style artwork, a seek bar, and playback controls, with support for following the app theme or choosing a custom theme.
- 🛠️ App Icon Fix: Fixed clipping on round and circular launchers.

🚀 Update Summary

Version: 2.0.2
Previous Version: 2.0.1

Enjoy a more polished interface, smoother interactions, smarter music organization, and greater control over your listening experience.

SKT Music Player — Your Music, Your Experience. 🎵
